entities.summary: Esther Termens Cañabate is a field hockey midfield player from Spain. She represented her native country at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece. Termens was a key member of the Spanish national team that finished fourth at the 2006 Women's Hockey World Cup in Madrid and of the 2003 Champions Challenge runners-up squad. Esther Termens was a athletes & competitors from Terrassa (b. 1984-11-02, Terrassa). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
